A '''Vomfrey sculpture''' was a type of valuable work of art that was worth several thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a Vomfrey sculpture was among a collection of rare artifacts owned by the financier [[Veilred Jydor]], which he kept inside his penthouse in the [[High Card Casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danteel]].
